remarks: Welcome to this stunning Glenbrook colonial, where timeless charm meets modern convenience! You'll be captivated by the spacious layout & thoughtful updates. The inviting living rm is the perfect place to unwind, featuring a fireplace & rich hw floors. Just beyond, a sun-drenched den/office/library w/built-in shelving offers a peaceful retreat. Cooking is a joy in the updated eat-in kitchen, boasting sleek concrete countertops, stylish open shelving, & warm cork flooring. The elegant dining room is perfect for hosting, complete w/a charming butler's pantry & a convenient powder room. Upstairs is home to a luxurious primary suite w/a private bath. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a spacious full hall bathroom. Need even more space? The finished third floor is a versatile bonus area, ready to become a fourth bedroom, home office, or creative studio, with yet another full bath. Enjoy the best of indoor-outdoor living in the screened-in three-season porch-ideal for relaxing, dining, and entertaining. The fully fenced backyard is a dream for pets & outdoor fun. Plus the basement offers ample storage & laundry space, w/direct access to the one-car garage. Practical perks include gas heat, solar panels (on back roof), & public water & sewer. Walk to Stark school, houses of worship, restaurants and just a quick stroll to downtown Stamford & to the Glenbrook train station, putting everything you need at your fingertips. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity!
